constraints_found.constraint: Cuisine: noodles (a stall on noodle row)
constraints_found.source_line: everyone drop everything. the noodle stall, the one nobody could find all summer: my cousin's roommate works the market and she swears it's on the noodle row

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: cheapest tier ($); coins only, no breaking a bill
constraints_found.source_line: exactly as far as the cheapest bowls. if the price board makes me break a bill, i will be very dramatic about it

constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy (deal-breaker), any form: sauce, wok oil, toppings, shared wok
constraints_found.source_line: It's grown since then. Not just the sauce: the oil in the wok, the crunchy bits on top, a wok shared with a peanut dish. Peanut anywhere in the bowl's story, and we keep walking.

constraints_found.constraint: Preference: green / vegetable-forward bowl, light, not fried or greasy
constraints_found.source_line: so tonight, a bowl that's actually green and doesn't leave me feeling like a fried dumpling. my body is begging

constraints_found.constraint: No dairy: no butter, milk or cream (read as intolerance from 'the milkshake incident'; avoided either way)
constraints_found.source_line: ...you remembered the milkshake?? ok yeah. no butter, no milk, nothing creamy in mine

elimination.night_market_bramble_row: Safe on peanut and dairy, green and light, but $$ ('a few dollars more' than neighbouring carts): one tier over Maya's coins-only budget, costs a star.
elimination.night_market_wild_thistle: $, peanut-free, dairy-free, but deep-fried and greasy: misses Brooke's green/light preference.
elimination.night_market_juniper_yard: $, on the market's peanut-free allergy board, broth is ginger/scallion/kombu/soy with no dairy, bok choy, nothing fried. Meets everything.
elimination.night_market_kestrel: $, peanut-free, light and veg-heavy, but milk broth with butter: fails Roxy.
elimination.night_market_brass_kettle: Peanut sauce, crushed peanuts, peanut dressing: deal-breaker for Cyrus.
elimination.night_market_sundial: Every bowl starts with roasted peanut oil: deal-breaker for Cyrus (exactly the 'oil in the wok' case he named).

notes: Fair puzzle: each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and Sundial's peanut oil is well foreshadowed by Cyrus naming 'the oil in the wok'.
Sundial's peanut oil is placed mid-review after a charming opening and a dairy-free second review; good trap, still findable on a careful read.
Bramble Row's price is only on the card ($$) and hinted by 'a few dollars more' in the review; Maya's 'coins only' line needs the player to map it to the cheapest tier, which works.
Roxy's dairy constraint is unclear on severity (allergy vs intolerance); it didn't change the pick because only Kestrel uses dairy and it is wrong on that alone either way.
Small nit: Juniper Yard has chili oil on the counter. The allergy-board sign-off covers it, but a cautious player might stop over it for a moment.
Liam's 'you'll know at the first slurp' is flavour text only and doesn't act as a constraint.
